page: Microsoft Azure E20s_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the ESv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 20 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 10 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX-512 instructions. The server is equipped with 160.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is provided via a 328 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom-quartile scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded compression tests. However, multi-core and memory-bound operations perform at an average level. The server achieves middle-tier results in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is stable, reaching 90.49 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 45.96 GB/sec for writes. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also fall within the average tier, processing 15.43 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E20s_v3 offers a dense memory profile relative to its compute allocation, making it a viable option for workloads that require large memory footprints without needing top-tier single-thread CPU performance. The combination of 160.0 GB of RAM, dedicated vCPUs, and local SSD storage makes this instance well-suited for relational databases, caching layers like Redis, multi-threaded software compilation, and medium-scale web serving.
description: The Microsoft Azure E20s_v3 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the ESv3 family, powered by a 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon 8272CL processor. It features 20 dedicated vCPUs (10 physical cores), 160.0 GB of RAM, and a 328 GB local SSD. While single-core benchmarks for this instance are positioned in the lower tier, its multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations consistently achieve average tier results. With an 8.0 GB RAM-per-vCPU ratio and Premium Storage capability, the E20s_v3 provides a balanced, memory-dense hardware profile. It is best suited for memory-intensive workloads, including database management systems, Redis caching layers, and multi-threaded enterprise applications.
